issues.display_title: Issue #28: [Feature] Client Action Intent Detection & Schema Support
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Enable the GoThru RAG copilot to detect client-side UI action intents (such as creating virtual tours or navigating to pages) and include a structured client_action payload in responses.

Key Changes

  • Add ClientActionEvent model schema to app/copilot/models.py.
  • Implement UI action intent detection in app/copilot/planner.py for virtual tour creation, navigation, etc.
  • Attach client_action to both action_available (imperative commands) and answer_only (informational Q&A) modes.
  • Support reading page context from context.page alongside conversation history.
  • Add unit test coverage for client action intent detection.

Part of Epic: Bidirectional Dashboard-RAG Integration
